_comment: Cross-TASK deploy coordination state — runtime SoT for parallel deployments. NOT committed to git (.gitignore). PR 18.6 will add the gitignore entry.
_status: DOCS-ONLY (PR 18): schema only, not yet consumed. Integration deferred to PR 18.1-18.6.

_invariants.V2.C4_dependency_source: dependencies[] DERIVES from state.json.tasks[ID].git.dependsOn (canonical SoT). Sync via PR 18.1 helper.
_invariants.V2.C5_bidirectional_invariant: If A.dependents contains B, then B.dependencies MUST contain A. Validator in PR 18.1.
_invariants.V2.C6_rule11_three_phase: migrations.phase enum: expand | backfill | contract (Rule 11). NOT just 'expand' alone — DROP requires three-phase.
_invariants.V2.W3_no_cycle_detection: Schema does not detect dependency cycles (A→B→A). PR 18.1 cascade walker must DAG-validate.
_invariants.V2.W4_stale_taskid: dependents[] may contain abandoned TASK-IDs. PR 18.1 cascade walker must filter via Rule 10 (.abandoned-tasks.txt).
_invariants.V2.W5_hotfix_namespace: PR 18.1+ should support taskId='HOTFIX-NNN' alongside 'TASK-NNN' for hotfix-during-deploy scenarios.
_invariants.V2.C3_param_format: sharedParametersChanged[] entries are objects {paramName, from, to, registeredAt}, aligned with Rule 18 parameter registry.
